$comment: Reviewed acceptances for HIGH/CRITICAL image findings that have no fix yet. Each needs a reason a reviewer can check and expires at most 90 days out. Changes need code-owner review (see .github/CODEOWNERS). Never covers KEV or fixable findings. Context for all entries below: the app container runs as uid 10001 with cap_drop ALL and no-new-privileges (docker-compose.yml), and the app imports only os and flask.

acceptances.reason: util-linux mount helper flaw; needs a privileged mount. The app never runs mount, and no-new-privileges stops the setuid /usr/bin/mount from gaining root. No Debian fix yet.
util-linux nsenter cgroup flaw; needs root to run nsenter. The app never runs it and the container has no capabilities. No Debian fix yet.
util-linux X-mount.subdir flaw; needs a privileged mount. The app never runs mount, and no-new-privileges stops the setuid /usr/bin/mount from gaining root. No Debian fix yet.
util-linux bind-mount flaw; needs a privileged mount. The app never runs mount, and no-new-privileges stops the setuid /usr/bin/mount from gaining root. No Debian fix yet.
systemd-homed privilege escalation; only the shared libraries are installed. systemd-homed and homectl are not in the image. No Debian fix yet.

libacl symlink-traversal privilege escalation; needs a privileged process using libacl on attacker-controlled paths. Nothing in the container runs privileged (uid 10001, no capabilities). No Debian fix yet.
ncurses buffer overflow; terminal library used by bash. The app never starts a shell and does not load curses (checked under gunicorn). No Debian fix yet.
OpenSSL QUIC frame-queue DoS. Python's ssl module has no QUIC support, gunicorn serves plain HTTP behind nginx (no TLS configured), and the app makes no outbound connections. No Debian fix yet.

OpenSSL QUIC stream memory-leak DoS. Python's ssl module has no QUIC support, gunicorn serves plain HTTP behind nginx (no TLS configured), and the app makes no outbound connections. No Debian fix yet.
SQLite FTS5 heap overflow. The app uses no database and sqlite3 is not loaded under gunicorn (checked). No Debian fix yet.
SQLite corrupted FTS5 index code execution. The app uses no database and sqlite3 is not loaded under gunicorn (checked). No Debian fix yet.
SQLite session changeset code execution. The app uses no database and sqlite3 is not loaded under gunicorn (checked). No Debian fix yet.
Perl Archive::Tar DoS. Archive::Tar is not installed (perl-base only) and the app never runs perl or handles tar files. Debian status: fix_deferred.
